what: When the section top edge touches the screen bottom it enters as a band clipped 10% on all sides, opens fully straight while rising .4 of the screen, and tightens back to 10% as it leaves (from when .6 of its own height remains). The values follow late at .15s so it feels smooth. Inner video panel (data-fx-part=media’s first child, 10% larger top and bottom) drifts 16% while passing, and when fx:play is sent it drops the offset to fit the panel exactly in .6s cubic-bezier(.625,.05,0,1), then returns on fx:rest

options.enter: Screen ratio to rise until fully open, default .4
options.leave: Remaining height ratio when re-tightening starts, default .6
options.[data-fx-part=media]: (If present) Video panel — the first child plays
options.fx:play · fx:rest: Event sent to the element — play when playback starts, rest when it stops

from.where: index.html .h-state (black statement band · video) — original StatementVideoBlock clip inset 10%
